info.title: GridCast-AU API
info.description: Read-only archive of GridCast-AU's scored outputs for Victoria (VIC1): LightGBM C demand forecasts with CQR prediction intervals, the M1 price baselines, actuals and anomaly events (recipe v2), for issue times 1 Aug 2023 → 30 Sep 2026 (NEM time). Timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC; inputs need an explicit offset (`Z`, or `%2B10:00` in a query string). See `/v1/meta` for provenance, scored metrics, disclosures and licences.
